Main.dc.html.title: Title v1a · live diorama: a small island of placed tiles slowly turns on the pastel backdrop, which drifts through the day (dawn, midday, dusk, night) as on the map. Continue opens the latest autosave; Load opens autosaves and save slots; Join a join code; Settings top right. Tweak firstLaunch hides Continue and makes New campaign the main button. Continue and New campaign don't link yet

Title-v1b-LastSave.dc.html.title: Title v1b · your last save: the player's own map from their latest save fills the screen, the camera drifting slowly over it, with its empty edge slots showing; the logo and menu sit on cream panels so they read over any map. The map drawn is a stand-in; a first launch would show a generic world

Title-v1c-Plain.dc.html.title: Title v1c · plain menu backdrop: the muted menu backdrop (as the character creator from v16), the logo big and centred, Continue on its own and the other buttons in a row under it

Title-v2a-HeadsOrHexes.dc.html.title: Title v2a · name: Heads or Hexes, on v1a. The coin carries "or"; a hex tile sits in front of Hexes

Title-v2b-FortunesHex.dc.html.title: Title v2b · name: Fortune's Hex, on v1a. A coin lies on a hex tile as the emblem

Icon-v1a-Tile.dc.html.title: App icon v1a · one painted hex tile: forest, village and a river on a tile with a wooden edge, on the dawn backdrop

Icon-v1b-Mini.dc.html.title: App icon v1b · a hero mini on its wooden hex base, standing on a meadow tile, on the midday backdrop. The mini is a stand-in drawing

Icon-v1c-Coin.dc.html.title: App icon v1c · the flip coin mid-toss, a hex with a tree struck on its face, on dark slate so it stands out on a home screen

v2.text: v2 · two new names on v1a (HexGen is v1a)
